learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the thrilling moves, breath control, and ultimate teamwork needed to master the ancient and action-packed game of Kabaddi!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A raider must continuously chant the word 'Kabaddi' in a single, unbroken breath while attacking the opponent's half. This incredible rule tests your lung capacity and stamina like a true warrior!
A successful raider needs explosive speed and quick reflexes. Your goal is to enter the enemy territory, tag one or more defenders, and escape safely back to your midline without getting caught.
Defenders work as a super tight unit called the 'antis'. They communicate silently and use strong, legal holds like the ankle catch or thigh hold to trap the raider before they can cross the midline.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Digroz Lung Capacity Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Take a deep breath and start chanting 'Kabaddi, Kabaddi' aloud. Time yourself to see how many seconds you can keep the chant going clearly without needing to take a second breath!

quick_recap: ⭐ Kabaddi is a unique sport that perfectly blends physical strength with intense breath control.
⭐ Raiders score points by bravely tagging opponents and returning to their home court.
⭐ Defenders must use clever chain formations and safe tackles to capture the raider.
